svg.title: Three impurity functions and one split
svg.desc: Each panel plots an impurity against the share of positives in a region. The parent with 900 positives and 100 negatives sits at 0.9; splitting it into 400/100 and 500/0 gives two equal children at 0.8 and 1.0, whose average loss is the midpoint of the dashed chord. For misclassification the chord lies on the curve and the gain is zero; for the strictly concave cross-entropy and Gini it lies below, and the gain is positive.
